messages:
Dana (Finance): Heads-up: Product wants to pilot a two-arm price experiment for scale customers next month. Need quick consensus on billing treatment for accounts that flip cohorts mid-billing-cycle, how we surface experiment metadata, and the grandfathering window. Pinging @Omar + @Tara.

Rhea (Product): Plan summary: control = current list, variant = new tiered volume discounts (earlier stepdown). Target 6% of scale accounts for 21 days. We want experiment_tag in the export rows and a lightweight audit field for assignment_reason. No visible invoice changes.

Omar (Billing Ops): Ops constraints: consolidated monthly invoices limit our ability to show per-experiment lines. We can add experiment_tag and assignment_date to exports easily. For mid-cycle cohort moves we can either prorate charges by assignment days or bill final usage and issue a reconciliation. My recommendation: provisional prorate on invoice, followed by a post-close reconciliation and automated credits/corrections per thresholds.

Ben (Sales): Sales asks that any customer on a signed discount schedule be excluded by default and only included if AM explicitly opts them in. Also want 60-day grandfathering for existing customers.

Tara (Legal): Exclusion rule OK. For grandfathering length I prefer a standard 90 days; contractual amendments get precedence. Also need approved customer-facing wording: "Existing agreements and active discount schedules are honored for 90 days after experiment assignment unless you opt in."

Dana (Finance): Decision points: 1) export metadata: yes (experiment_tag + assignment_date) 2) invoice PDF changes: no 3) default grandfather: 90d (exemptions for signed discounts) 4) mid-cycle: provisional prorate + recon. Any objections?

Rhea (Product): No objections. Acceptance metrics: revenue variance within +/-2% for cohort, <1% increase in billing disputes, and successful attribution via experiment_tag in exports.

Omar (Billing Ops): Vendor note: payments-bot shows Chargebee supports invoice.custom_fields but those are limited and may not appear in exported PDFs. We'll rely on export fields for analytics. For corrections: corrected invoice when gateway supports it; otherwise credit note. Thresholds proposed: >$60 corrected invoice, $10-$60 credit, < $10 auto-credit.

payments-bot: Chargebee API: supports invoice.custom_fields and notes. Corrected invoice flow not supported via single API call; workflow = create credit_note + new invoice (or include references in notes).

Ben (Sales): Confirming: exclude signed deals by default. Will send CSV of affected accounts by EOD.

Tara (Legal): I'll draft the short customer email and the contract addendum language. Dana, can you confirm grandfathering period final?

Dana (Finance): Going with 90d per legal preference. Omar, please draft the runbook with prorate formula, recon cadence, and thresholds. Include an escalation path for adjustments > $3k (Finance review).

Omar (Billing Ops): Will do. Also will add an experimental flag to the billing_export schema and run a staging backfill for assignment_date. I'll post sample CSV in #eng-billing when done.

Rhea (Product): Thanks. Once runbook and sample export are up we can start assignment of the 6% cohort to staging for QA.

Dana (Finance): Final note: if the gateway forces credit-note workaround, list the process for customer communications in the runbook so AMs can explain. Thanks everyone.
